text:
Asking rents in Chemnitz stand at a median of 6.10 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.2% on the year and +15.0% over five years. That ranks Chemnitz #37 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 16% above the 2022 average contract rent of 5.26 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 366 € a month in cold rent, 8.8% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 61 days and 8% are gone within a week; with 9.4% market-active vacancy and +1.0% population growth over five years, the market looks slack.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 6.21 €/m² (+1.7%), with an 80% range of 6.07 to 6.41 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
